purpose: ケヤキクリエイト「制作イメージ」: Webバナー（横長）の背景ビジュアル。架空のスイーツ店の夏フェアのサンプル
prompt: Vivid summer key visual for a fictional dessert shop web banner: a tall glass of colourful fruit shaved ice with mango, strawberry and mint, glistening with water droplets, placed on the right side of the frame against a bright turquoise-to-sky-blue gradient background with soft sun flare. The entire left half is clean uncluttered turquoise space reserved for a headline. Fresh, cheerful, high-end advertising photography.
